zh.title: 華航首度於長程線添加40%永續燃油 飛往阿姆斯特丹
zh.summary: 華航飛荷蘭示範航班首度添加百分之四十永續航空燃油以減少碳排
body: 中華航空於2026年9月14日宣布，該公司於9月13日從桃園飛往荷蘭阿姆斯特丹的長程線航班中，首度添加了40%的永續航空燃油（SAF），藉此響應天合聯盟（SkyTeam）所舉辦的「航空飛行挑戰」（The Aviation Challenge, TAC）。這是華航自2022年以來第8次添加永續燃油，也是首次在長程航線上添加高達40%比例的永續燃油。
華航總經理陳漢銘表示，本次示範航班所使用的永續航空燃油量約為36.3噸，預估可減少約93.2公噸的二氧化碳排放。此減碳效果相當於每年四分之一個大安森林公園的碳吸附量，或是40輛小客車的碳排放量。陳漢銘指出，選擇阿姆斯特丹作為目的地，是因為荷蘭在永續倡議方面的發展非常成熟，值得學習與借鏡。
除了添加永續燃油之外，該示範航班還實施了多項減重與低碳措施。華航在航班上全面更換了輕量化餐盤與餐具，使餐具減重幅度達到30%，直接降低了飛機的載重與油耗。此外，機上的菜單與酒單均採用環保的大豆油墨進行印刷，並提供米其林綠星蔬食餐廳「小小樹食」的餐點，以鼓勵旅客選擇低碳飲食，並推廣使用線上登機證。
針對永續航空燃油的高昂成本是否會反映在機票價格上，陳漢銘說明，過去永續燃油的成本大約是一般燃油的2.5倍至3倍。他指出，目前新加坡航空在永續燃油領域的運作較為成熟，他希望華航能先達到與新加坡航空相同的成熟度，未來若獲得市場和旅客的認同，才會考慮效仿新加坡航空，將相關成本反映在票價上。

en.title: China Airlines Uses 40% Sustainable Aviation Fuel on Amsterdam Flight
en.summary: China Airlines uses a forty percent sustainable aviation fuel blend on its September 13 Amsterdam flight.
body: China Airlines announced on September 14, 2026, that it participated in SkyTeam's "The Aviation Challenge" (TAC) by adding a 40% blend of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) to its September 13 flight from Taoyuan to Amsterdam. This represents the carrier's first time using a 40% SAF blend on a long-haul route, and its eighth time incorporating SAF since 2022.

According to China Airlines General Manager Chen Han-ming, the demonstration flight utilized approximately 36.3 tonnes of SAF, which is estimated to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by about 93.2 metric tons. This reduction is equivalent to the annual carbon absorption of a quarter of Daan Forest Park or the annual emissions of 40 passenger cars. Chen noted that Amsterdam was chosen because the Netherlands has a mature environment for sustainability initiatives.

In addition to the SAF blend, the flight implemented various other weight reduction and low-carbon measures. China Airlines fully replaced its tableware with lightweight alternatives, achieving a 30% reduction in weight to directly decrease aircraft weight and fuel consumption. Onboard menus and wine lists were printed with eco-friendly soy ink, and the airline partnered with Michelin Green Star restaurant "Little Tree Food" to offer vegetarian meals, while encouraging passengers to use online boarding passes.

Regarding whether the higher cost of SAF would be reflected in ticket prices, Chen explained that SAF has historically cost 2.5 to 3 times more than conventional fuel. He noted that Singapore Airlines has a mature approach in this area. Chen expressed hope that China Airlines can first reach the level of maturity seen in Singapore Airlines before considering whether to follow its practice of reflecting SAF costs in ticket prices.

zh.title: 華航預計年底交付2架波音787-9客機 未來規模達24架
zh.summary: 華航預計年底引進2架波音787-9新機；未來機隊將達24架；首航擬飛亞洲航線
body: 中華航空積極推進機隊升級計畫。華航總經理陳漢銘表示，華航採購全新波音787-9客機，目標設定於今年底交付2架，並計畫於明年再交付12架客機。陳漢銘指出，新機隊的引進不僅是機隊的汰舊換新，更能降低20%的油耗以及30%的噪音，對營運效率與環保表現皆有明顯助益。
針對新機交付的實際時程，陳漢銘說明，先前由於座椅測試碰撞等因素，導致整體交機進度有所延宕。不過目前相關工作推進進度保持正向發展，華航仍維持今年底前接收2架波音787-9客機的既定目標。華航規劃未來波音787機隊規模將達到24架，其中包括18架波音787-9與6架波音787-10，新機自今年起陸續交付後，規劃將優先投入執飛首爾與大阪等亞洲區域航線。
除了機隊更新規劃外，中華航空亦積極推動永續航空發展。華航宣布今年第5度響應天合聯盟「航空飛行挑戰」，並於9月13日自桃園飛往阿姆斯特丹的長程線航班中，首度添加40%的永續航班燃油，以具體行動朝向2050年淨零碳排的環保目標邁進。
在整體營運與財務表現方面，陳漢銘指出，雖然今年航空用油價格波動較大，但華航透過檢視運能配置、依據載客需求更換機型，以及發揮貨運腹艙載貨效益等策略應對。若撇開油價波動影響，華航今年營收表現遠優於去年，客運業務在7月與8月表現亮眼，貨運月營收亦達到新台幣70億元至80億元的高收益水平。陳漢銘對今年全年營運成果與年終獎金目標抱持審慎樂觀態度。

en.title: China Airlines Targets Delivery of Two Boeing 787-9 Aircraft by Year-End
en.summary: China Airlines expects two Boeing 787-9 deliveries by year-end, targeting 24 overall 787 aircraft.
body: China Airlines is advancing its fleet renewal strategy, with plans to take delivery of its first two newly acquired Boeing 787-9 passenger aircraft by the end of this year. President Chen Han-ming stated during a media interview that the carrier aims to receive two Boeing 787-9 aircraft by year-end, followed by an additional 12 aircraft scheduled for delivery next year. Chen noted that introducing the new fleet will replace older aircraft while reducing fuel consumption by 20 percent and lowering noise levels by 30 percent.

Addressing the timeline for delivery, Chen explained that schedules experienced delays due to seat collision testing requirements. However, he emphasized that progress is currently moving in a positive direction, keeping the target of receiving two Boeing 787-9 jets before the end of the year intact. Looking ahead, China Airlines plans to build a total Boeing 787 fleet of 24 aircraft, comprising 18 787-9s and six 787-10s. Deliveries will proceed progressively starting this year, with initial deployments planned for regional Asian routes such as Seoul and Osaka.

Alongside its fleet modernization efforts, China Airlines is advancing its environmental initiatives. The carrier announced its fifth participation in the SkyTeam "The Aviation Challenge" (TAC), adding 40 percent Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) for the first time on a long-haul flight from Taoyuan to Amsterdam on September 13. This move forms part of the airline's strategy to support the broader goal of achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.

Regarding commercial operations, Chen highlighted that despite significant fuel price volatility this year, China Airlines adjusted capacity and aircraft deployment based on passenger demand. Excluding fuel price fluctuations, revenue has significantly outperformed last year's figures, supported by strong passenger demand in July and August alongside monthly cargo revenue reaching NT$7 billion to NT$8 billion. Consequently, management remains cautiously optimistic about full-year financial performance and employee year-end bonuses.

zh.title: airBaltic 在美申請第11章破產保護 獲4.05億美元融資承諾
zh.summary: 拉脫維亞國營航空申請第11章重組；航班正常；獲3.5億歐元融資承諾
body: 拉脫維亞旗艦航空公司 airBaltic 於 2026 年 9 月 14 日向美國紐約南區破產法院申請第11章破產保護，啟動法院監督的債務重組程序。航空公司聲明稱，航班運營、機票銷售、訂位系統及客戶服務將在整個過程中維持正常。現有機票、優惠券與抵用額度均保持有效。

根據 airBaltic 發布的資訊，公司已獲得由 Strategic Value Partners 主導、Barclays、Hayfin Capital Management、Morgan Stanley 及 Oaktree Capital Management 參與的 3.5 億歐元（約 4.05 億美元）債務人佔有融資承諾。該融資利率為 SOFR 加 8%，按當前利率換算約為 12%，尚待法院批准。airBaltic 預計在第11章程序於 2027 年 6 月左右完成。
執行長 Erno Hildén 指出：「我們的重心是持續經營航空業務，同時落實新商業計畫的變革。」他強調旅客不會感受到重組影響，航空公司將繼續飛行、售票並規劃未來班表。此次申請前，airBaltic 經歷數月嚴重流動性壓力，9 月 3 日曾宣佈 2.57 億歐元過渡性融資協議，8 月債券持有人批准修改 3.8 億歐元債券條款，包括延遲付息與暫免最低流動性要求。
燃油價格因美伊戰爭飆升進一步惡化財務狀況，airBaltic 此前未對燃油需求進行對沖，導致極度暴露於價格衝擊。財務壓力在最新地緣政治衝擊前已存在，包括高債務與飛機租賃成本。重組標誌著擴張策略的劇烈逆轉：目前機隊為 54 架空中巴士 A220-300，新計畫將於 2026 年底縮減至 36 架，2031 年逐步恢復至約 40 架，遠低於先前規劃的 100 架目標。
2025 年 airBaltic 載運 520 萬旅客，營收 7.793 億歐元，淨虧損 4430 萬歐元。拉脫維亞政府持股 88.37% 為控股股東，漢莎航空集團於 2025 年取得 10% 少數股權。總理 Andris Kulbergs 表示政府持續尋找戰略投資人，認為第11章程序為航空公司贏得實施重組所需的時間與法律工具。
第11章破產保護並非清算，而是允許企業在法院監督下繼續經營、重組債務與合同，並獲得自動中止令保護免受大多數債權人追索。過去美國航空、聯合航空、達美航空、LATAM、墨西哥航空、Avianca、GOL 及 SAS 均曾透過第11章重組，但 Spirit Airlines 經歷兩次第11章後仍最終倒閉，凸顯程序不保證成功。

en.title: airBaltic Files for Chapter 11 in US with $405 Million DIP Financing Commitment
en.summary: Latvian flag carrier seeks court-supervised restructuring; flights continue; €350m financing lined up
body: Latvia's flag carrier airBaltic filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York on 14 September 2026, launching a court-supervised restructuring to reduce debt while keeping flights operating. The airline stated that scheduled flights, ticket sales, reservations and customer services would continue normally throughout the process, and that existing tickets, vouchers and credits remain valid.

According to airBaltic, the company has secured commitments for €350 million ($405 million) in debtor-in-possession financing from a group including Strategic Value Partners, Barclays, Hayfin Capital Management, Morgan Stanley and Oaktree Capital Management. The financing, which remains subject to court approval, carries an interest rate of SOFR plus 8%, equivalent to around 12% at current rates. airBaltic expects to complete the Chapter 11 process around June 2027.

President and CEO Erno Hildén said: "Our focus is on continuing to run the airline while implementing the changes set out in our new business plan." He added that passengers should not notice the restructuring, with the airline continuing to fly, sell tickets and plan future schedules. The filing follows months of severe liquidity pressure. On 3 September 2026, airBaltic announced a €257 million interim financing agreement, and in August bondholders approved changes to €380 million in outstanding bonds, including deferral of interest payments and a temporary waiver of minimum liquidity requirements.

The airline's difficulties were sharply aggravated by the rise in oil and jet fuel prices following the outbreak of the US-Iran war. airBaltic had not hedged its fuel requirements against the increase, leaving it particularly exposed. Financial pressures predated the geopolitical shock and included high debt and aircraft leasing costs. The restructuring marks a dramatic reversal of airBaltic's earlier expansion plans: the carrier currently operates an all-Airbus A220-300 fleet of 54 aircraft, but the new business plan announced in August 2026 will reduce the fleet to 36 aircraft by the end of 2026 before gradually returning to around 40 by 2031, down from a previous target of up to 100 A220-300s.

In 2025, airBaltic carried 5.2 million passengers and generated €779.3 million in revenue but recorded a net loss of €44.3 million. The Latvian government remains the controlling shareholder with an 88.37% stake, while Lufthansa Group acquired a 10% minority holding in 2025. Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said the government continues to seek a strategic investor while the company restructures its obligations and reduces its fleet, viewing Chapter 11 as one of the best options for ensuring airBaltic's viability.

Chapter 11 is a restructuring process under the US Bankruptcy Code that permits a company to continue trading while reorganising finances and operations under court supervision and protection from most creditor enforcement. Airlines including American Airlines, United Airlines, Delta Air Lines, LATAM Airlines, Aeroméxico, Avianca, GOL and SAS have used Chapter 11 to reorganise, though Spirit Airlines ultimately ceased operations after two filings, demonstrating that Chapter 11 does not guarantee survival.
